personality_one_liner: A structured, fresh, and vibrant Indian salad planner that lets beautiful food photography shine against soft cream canvases with playful floating veggie micro-animations.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native margins (lg/xl) around main content blocks, with tighter (sm/md) grouping inside cards.

do's: Bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind
Sticky header backgrounds over scrolling content

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Mock Google Sign-in gateway with vibrant fresh imagery.

states.loading: Stylized floating veggies (avocados, tomatoes) with a spinner.
states.error: Standard error toast or inline alert.

screens.layout: Hero image filling top 50% with vertical gradient scrim fading into surface color. Brand logo/wordmark. Large 'Sign in with Google' pill button at the bottom (brandSecondary / Carrot Orange for pop).

screens.name: OnboardingQuestionnaire
screens.purpose: 10-step preference setup chunked into 3 manageable screens to reduce drop-off, capturing diet, goals, allergies, and logistics.

states.loading: Floating veggies + nuts (almonds, walnuts) transitioning between steps.

screens.layout: Linear progress bar (no numbers) at top. Chunked screens: 1. Goals & Profile (Fitness goal, Calorie Target, Diet Type). 2. Taste (Proteins, Spice tolerance, Dressing style, Allergies). 3. Logistics (Prep time, Budget, Meal slot). Use tap-to-advance cards, tag grids, and sliders with edge labels. Bottom sticky 'Next' button.

screens.name: HomePlanner
screens.purpose: Dashboard showing today's macro targets and weekly meal calendar.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for calendar and donut chart.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty salad bowl + CTA 'Plan your first salad'.

screens.layout: Header with compressed weekly calendar strip. Below: Macro/Calorie dashboard featuring a Reanimated Donut Chart (Carbs/Protein/Fats % matching brand greens/orange). Below: 'Today's Salads' horizontal scrolling cards. FAB for Instagram sharing.

screens.name: RecipeDetail
screens.purpose: Granular recipe viewer with scalable portions and step-by-step prep instructions.

states.loading: Full screen spinner with floating nut illustrations.
states.error: Failed to load recipe - Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image with strict gradient scrim (0% to 70%+ surfaceInverse) for high contrast text overlay (Recipe Title & Prep Time). Portion Scaler (+/- pills) sticky below header. Granular ingredients list (grams/ml) with checkmarks. Step-by-step instructions. Bottom sticky CTA 'Add to Planner'.

screens.name: GroceryList
screens.purpose: Smart, categorized shopping list for the planned meals.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty shopping bag + 'Your planner is empty'.
states.error: Failed to load grocery sync - Retry CTA.

screens.layout: SectionList grouped by categories (Produce, Proteins, Condiments, Nuts & Seeds). Each item has a checkbox. Checked items move to a collapsed 'Completed' section at the bottom.

recipe_hero_sprouts.alt: Indian sprouted moong salad in a dark bowl

onboarding_bg_veggies.alt: Vibrant tomatoes and cucumbers under sunlight

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: Leaf Green (#2E7D32) and Carrot Orange (#EF6C00) must be the primary accents against the soft cream surface (#FDFBF7).
Implement stylized floaters (avocados, cucumbers, tomatoes, almonds, walnuts) using react-native-reanimated. Trigger these during loading states, page transitions, and the onboarding flow.

The 10-step questionnaire must NOT be 10 separate screens. Chunk them into 3 logical steps (Goals, Taste, Logistics) using vertical stack grids and tap-to-advance cards to prevent user drop-off. Show a linear progress bar without numbers.
On the Recipe Detail screen, ensure the Hero Image uses a STRICT gradient scrim (0% transparent to 70%+ opacity of surfaceInverse) to guarantee WCAG text readability on the overlaid Recipe Title.
Build the Calorie & Macro dashboard using a donut chart for Carbs/Protein/Fats %. Use reanimated for smooth rendering of the chart upon screen load.
Grocery list must be grouped by exactly these categories: Produce, Proteins, Condiments, Nuts & Seeds.
Include an Instagram Share action (mocked behavior) that generates a snapshot-friendly card with predefined viral hashtags.
Use mock data throughout (Mock Google Sign-in, Mock Recipe data).
